name: gfx_alloc
notes: n=0: returns A000h. else DOS-allocs FA00h bytes (one page), returns its segment; failure prints "Insufficient memory for MCGA graphics" and exits

name: text_clip_y_r
notes: text with vertical clip (ymin/ymax of ctx); register entry of 7

name: text_clip_xl_r
notes: text with left clip (xmin); register entry of 8

name: text_clip_xr_r
notes: text with right clip (xmax); register entry of 10

name: text_noclip_r
notes: text without clipping; register entry of 5

name: text_noclip
notes: draw string, no clipping; c->x updated to the end x

name: text_clip_all_r
notes: text with right+left+vertical clip; register entry of 9

name: hud_tick_strip
notes: draws a vertical tick scale (HUD tape) at one of 4 fixed columns on the draw segment (see spec)

name: blit_key
notes: copy rect from segment b->seg to page b->dpage, source byte 0 = transparent, no clipping

name: sprite_scaled_r
notes: draw part of 22 (after clip); not called by the programs

name: sprite_scaled
type: RectP *sprite_scaled(SpriteCtx *w, int x, int y, int dw, int dh, unsigned off, unsigned seg)
notes: clipped scaled/mirrored draw of a pool sprite; returns far ptr to visible rect (x,y,w,h words)

name: offset_set
notes: draw offset := off (used by line, pixel, poly, 48; NOT by text/blits/sprites)

name: line
notes: Bresenham line in current colour on draw segment+offset, no clipping

name: pixel_last
notes: plot one pixel at the last line() start point (unused by programs)

name: poly_fill
notes: span fill between edge tables; mode 0 solid, 1 OR, 2 AND, else shade 98h+

name: rect_recolor
type: void rect_recolor(int *page, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int old, int new)
notes: replace colour old by new inside the rect of page *page

name: blit_rect
type: void blit_rect(int spage, int sx, int sy, int dpage, int dx, int dy, int w, int h)
notes: opaque rectangle copy between pages (row by row, no overlap handling)

name: flip
notes: copy AX words page[1] -> A000 (unless the disable word 019C:11DC is non-zero); sets flag 45

name: flip_flag
notes: AL := 1 if the last 44 copied, 0 if it was disabled

name: explosion_fx_tick
notes: per-frame: DAC[13] := random red/yellow, CRTC start-address-low shake while counter 79 > 0

name: font_char_width
notes: advance width incl. spacing, 0 if the glyph does not exist

name: page_load
notes: copy 64000 bytes from srcseg to the draw segment (offset 0, ignores draw offset)

name: mem_paras_free
notes: largest free DOS block in paragraphs (INT 21/48 probe); 0 if none

name: scanline_put
notes: copy 320 bytes (160 words) from SS:BP to ES:DI

name: mode13_set
notes: INT 10h AX=0013h; verifies INT 10h/0Fh = 13h else prints "MCGA is not supported on your machine" and exits

name: palette16_set
notes: DAC 0..15 := table n (0..4) via INT 10h/1012h, then screen on (70); not called by the programs

name: screen_off
notes: wait retrace, blank the display (3D8h:=2, sequencer reg1 bit5)

name: screen_on
notes: wait retrace, unblank (3D8h:=0Ah, sequencer reg1 bit5 cleared)

name: page_seg_set_b
notes: page table[page] := seg (argument order differs from 57)

name: pool_init
notes: take ALL free DOS memory as the sprite pool; AX = base segment, 0 if none

name: sprite_grab
type: unsigned sprite_grab(int page, int x, int y, int w, int h)
notes: RLE-compress a page rectangle into the pool; returns the sprite segment, 0 if the pool is exhausted

name: pool_free
notes: shrink the pool to what was used (free it if nothing); clears pool state

name: pic_to_page
notes: decode a .PIC into page `page` (slots 56/59, rows via 51+53); reader callback 81C6

name: pic_to_seg_b
notes: as above, reader 819D with buffer pos 200h

name: pic_row
notes: decode 320 pixels into the row buffer (DS:8C20)

name: pic_begin
notes: read header byte, maxbits, pixel width; LZW reset

name: rle90_fill
notes: RLE-90 expander; writes n pixels (nibbles x2 when 4-bit)

name: lzw_next
notes: next decoded byte; private stack for the string, reload via callback at [8D6A]

name: gfx_fill_rect
type: void gfx_fill_rect(Win *w, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
notes: solid rect via edge tables + slot 40; saves/restores the draw segment; w->page, w->colour at +4
